The '''''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle''', also known as the '''''Flarestar''-class Weequay ship''', the '''''Penumbra''-class attack shuttle''', or the '''Weequay saucer craft''', was a small saucer-shaped [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Pirate_arrival.png|thumb|left|175px|The [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] saucer craft lands on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].]]
The ''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle could be launched from the [[Surronian cruiser]]-based [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]] and land on surfaces too small for the mothership. It was at least 1/11 the size of the carrier vessel. The saucer craft had a dual cockpit design, with [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] canopies on the dorsal surface of the saucer.<ref name="DC" />

On the ventral side, the vessel had two thrusters, two laser cannons, missile launchers and three boarding ramps. Two on the front side leading towards the two cockpits and another one located on the back for passengers/cargo.<ref name="TGG" /> Hondo Ohnaka confiscated several of these ships from a collector in [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana]].<ref name="VGUB">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> The mark of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] pirate crew was painted on both sides of the ship.<ref name="DC" />

==History==
A [[Unidentified Flarestar-class attack shuttle (Ohnaka Gang)/Legends|ship]] of this kind transported [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and Ohnaka to the surface of Florrum, after the pirates found him on [[Vanqor]].<ref name="DC" /> Later, [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]], an accomplice of [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], used another saucer to attack and take down a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] bringing a [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] proving that the craft was very capable as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] against enemy craft. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] used the vessel as an escape craft after breaking out of the Weequay prison, killing the two [[Treason|treacherous]] pirates before taking the ship.<ref name="TGG" />

[[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], a Weequay [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], crash landed on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in a [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|''Flarestar''-class ship]] when he was shot by a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Confederate frigate]]. He was then found by Ohnaka and two other pirates.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part 1">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]]</ref>

Several of these shuttles were used by the Ohnaka gang members who decided to work for [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Three were deployed from their larger [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]] opening fire on the base, with the pirates taking cover but Hondo Okhana was the only one standing his ground.<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The craft was first named a ''Flarestar-class attack shuttle'' by the webcomic [[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)]], but in ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' it was named a ''Penumbra-class attack shuttle''.
